adapterWarnings: interval ('+N') heightening text is not a pure damage bump — kept as a description appendix only, not structurally represented

description.value:
You reach through time and pull a creature's wounds backward, rewinding the damage into the past and redirecting it through yourself as a conduit. Choose the number of Hit Points to restore to the target, up to 3d8+24. You take 1d6 void damage for every 6 Hit Points restored, rounding up to the next multiple of 6; this damage can't be reduced by resistance, immunity, or any other means, since you're absorbing it directly, but it can be healed normally afterward.

Heightened (+1) The maximum healing increases by 1d8+8.

target.value: 1 willing living creature other than yourself
